notes: Access: direct fetch worked throughout, no blocking encountered (curl_cffi/impersonation, Jina, or translate.goog were never needed). Platform is a custom Shopify Oxygen/Hydrogen storefront (cdn.shopify.com/oxygen-v2 assets); category taxonomy discovered via /sitemap-categories.xml (537 URLs, filtered down to genuine listing pages; most other entries are single named-product 'shop the look' pages, not categories, e.g. /lennon/, /alba/). Qty verified on every row via the page's own rendered 'N products' header, cross-confirmed against the identical N in the page's own 'X of N products are displayed' load-more footer text (both extracted independently by probe.py from the same fetch); every leaf in this file passed that double-match. Excluded per standing rules: Light Bulbs (not fixtures), Christmas Lights (holiday), Scented Candles and the scented majority implied by 'candles-candle-holders' parent, Dried Flowers & Artificial Flowers, all Rugs/Textiles/Bedding/Curtains/Table Linen, all Cutlery (cutlery/cutlery-sets/serving-cutlery/individual-cutlery), Storage/Furniture/Wardrobes/Beds, Bathroom Accessories/bins/storage/toothbrush-holders/toilet-brushes/soap-dispensers (functional bathroom hardware), Kitchen Storage/Appliances/Cookware/Utensils/Bakeware/Chopping Boards/Spice Mills/Vinegar-Oil Bottles/Sink Organisers/Wine Racks/Bread Bins/Food Storage Containers, Thermos/Thermal Flasks (functional insulated flasks), Bar Accessories (cocktail shakers/wine stoppers/foil cutters - explicit 'bar tools' exclusion), Serving Accessories (sampled: dominated by salt-and-pepper mills, spice mills and vinegar/oil bottles - kitchen tools, not decorative tableware), Kids Decoration (sampled: dominated by cotton canopies/throws/garlands/money boxes/birthday-party goods, not genuine decor product types), Office Accessories, Pet Supplies, Gifts/Gift Cards, all Christmas/Advent nodes. Two true duplicate-URL cases dropped per Rule 0.6: 'Ceiling Spotlights' is byte-identical in population to 'Ceiling Lights' (same 192 total, same sampled product slugs) and '/plant-pots-planters/' is an identical duplicate of '/plant-pots-outdoor/' (same 82 total, same sampled slugs) - canonical URL kept in each case, duplicate dropped. 'Decorative Mirrors' (/decorative-mirrors-1/, 26 products) was dropped as a style/facet re-cut of Wall Mirrors/Full-Length Mirrors (partial slug overlap observed, titles are 'Wall Mirror'/'Leaner Mirror'/'Floor Mirror' - existing types, not a new type or room branch). Two genuine type-vs-room overlaps kept and documented per Rule 0.6 rather than dropped: Bedside Lamps vs Table Lamps, and Flower Pots vs Plant Pots Indoor. Rule 0 gain: Kids Lighting (13) and Outdoor Lights' four room-split children (Wall/Table/Floor/Pendant, 39+143+44+26) were kept despite room words in their names - all genuine lighting fixtures. Two categories found to be genuinely empty (0 products, confirmed via 'numberOfItems':0 JSON-LD and '0 of 0 products are displayed' text) and excluded as non-functioning nodes rather than real categories: Outdoor Fairy Lights, Torches & Lanterns.
